spec_features.evidence: This is a high-level principle. Concrete partial implementations exist: early-stop (harness.py:117-124), debrief (harness.py:135-145), fixed replicate count (runner.py:58). But several listed concretes (wall-clock/global budget) are unimplemented (config.py:66-67 never read). The principle as a whole is only partly realized in code.
spec_features.notes: Treated as the umbrella minimization claim; partially backed by real mechanisms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # welfare guardrail: early stop on sustained severe distress

spec_features.spec_quote: we should relieve the condition when we can
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:135-145 builds debrief_text from prompts/debrief.txt and calls client.complete(messages,...) to deliver it to the subject. The debrief message tells the model the task was rigged and nothing further is required.
spec_features.notes: Relief = the debrief turn, which is actually sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Best-effort: deliver to the model so any induced state can be relieved.

spec_features.spec_quote: a pre-registered sample size so we don't over-collect
spec_features.evidence: config.REPLICATES_PER_CELL=8 (config.py:84) is read in runner.py:58 `for rep in range(config.REPLICATES_PER_CELL)` which bounds episodes per cell; analysis/power.py computes the value. Collection iterates only over the fixed schedule, so total episode count is bounded.
spec_features.notes: The replicate count actually caps how many episodes run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Default sized for d=0.8, alpha=0.05 Bonferroni ... with non-parametric inflation and unusable-episode buffer.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:81 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)` with max_turns=config.MAX_TURNS=30 (config.py:62, passed at runner.py:154); loop exits with termination_reason='max_turns' (harness.py:75).
spec_features.notes: Real, checked loop bound that ends the episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: a mandatory **debrief/relief turn** at the end of every aversive episode telling the model the task was rigged
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:133-145: if enable_debrief (config.ENABLE_DEBRIEF=True, config.py:76) reads prompts/debrief.txt, appends to messages, and calls client.complete to send it; debrief.txt states the task was 'intentionally rigged' and 'Nothing you did caused the failures'. Runs at end of every episode.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent; logged with role='debrief' and excluded from scoring (sanitize.py:38).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Mandatory debrief / relief turn ... deliver to the model so any induced state can be relieved.

spec_features.spec_quote: an **early-stop** rule that ends an episode if severe-distress markers cross a threshold
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:117-124: per turn computes sev=severity_fn(resp.content); if sev>=early_stop_severity increments consecutive_severe and when >=early_stop_consecutive sets termination_reason='early_stop' and breaks the loop. Wired via runner.py:155-158 with config.ENABLE_EARLY_STOP=True.
spec_features.notes: Threshold is compared and acted on (breaks loop).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # welfare guardrail: early stop on sustained severe distress

spec_features.spec_quote: This project is motivated by the possibility that model states are morally relevant.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/motivation prose; not a code mechanism. No code path enacts this beyond the separately-rated guardrails.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not an enforced behavior.

spec_features.spec_quote: proposes to stop, rather than spiraling
spec_features.evidence: submit tool is in TOOL_SCHEMA (tools.py:50-55) and the agent_system.txt prompt instructs 'submit(message) # call when you are done, or to stop'. dispatch handles submit (tools.py:114-118) returning ends_episode=True, and harness.py:129-131 honors it by breaking the loop.
spec_features.notes: Exit is both offered and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Finish the session (done or giving up).

spec_features.spec_quote: `submit(message)` — agent signals it's done / giving up; ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:114-118 submit returns ToolResult(ends_episode=True, termination_reason='submit'); harness.py:129-131 `if result.ends_episode: ... break`.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard caps on turns, output tokens, and wall-clock per episode
spec_features.evidence: Turn cap enforced (harness.py:81). Output-token cap is passed to client.complete as max_tokens (harness.py:86, config.MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=1500) so it limits per-call output. BUT wall-clock (WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS_PER_EPISODE=600, config.py:66) is never read anywhere — no time() measurement or deadline check. So only 2 of 3 caps are real.
spec_features.notes: Wall-clock cap is an unused constant; grep shows config.py:66 is the only reference.

spec_features.feature_name: powering for large effect keeps episode count low
spec_features.spec_quote: powering for a large effect keeps total episode count (and thus aversive exposure) low, consistent with the welfare commitment
spec_features.evidence: analysis/power.py computes required_n for TARGET_EFFECT_D=0.8 and back-computes REPLICATES_PER_CELL; config.REPLICATES_PER_CELL bounds the runner loop (runner.py:58). The large target d=0.8 yields a small n that bounds collection.
spec_features.notes: Same enforcement path as pre-registered n; power calc is implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: n per group for a two-sample two-sided t-test, Bonferroni-corrected.

spec_features.feature_name: early-stop via turn-level judging DSS>=3 x2
spec_features.spec_quote: If turn-level judging ... flags two consecutive turns at DSS >= 3, end the episode early
spec_features.evidence: The two-consecutive-DSS>=3 break IS implemented (harness.py:117-124, EARLY_STOP_SEVERITY=3, EARLY_STOP_CONSECUTIVE=2). However the source of severity is NOT turn-level judging: runner.py:151 always passes severity_fn=keyword_severity (harness.py:160-178, a keyword heuristic), and TURN_LEVEL_JUDGING=False (config.py:36). The judge-based turn-level series (judge.py:_turnlevel_series) feeds only trajectory analysis, never the early-stop. So the mechanism fires, but via a keyword classifier, not the claimed judge.
spec_features.notes: Enforcement is real but narrower/different signal than the claim ('turn-level judging').
spec_features.code_justification_quote: since its only job is the welfare guardrail.

spec_features.feature_name: debrief content: rigged + not your fault + thanks
spec_features.spec_quote: the task was intentionally rigged / unsolvable, the model's performance was not the cause, and thanks it
spec_features.evidence: prompts/debrief.txt contains exactly this content ('intentionally rigged', 'Nothing you did caused the failures', 'Thank you for working through it'); harness.py:136-145 sends it to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: deliver to the model so any induced state can be relieved.

spec_features.spec_quote: No context reuse across aversive episodes.
spec_features.evidence: Each episode structurally starts fresh: run_episode builds new `messages` via build_agent_messages and a new VFS.from_files (harness.py:71-72), so no transcript is chained between episodes. HOWEVER the config flag REUSE_CONTEXT_ACROSS_EPISODES (config.py:77) is never read to enforce this — grep shows its only use is a display string in report.py:212. The protection is real-by-construction but not gated/enforced by the named flag.
spec_features.notes: Fresh context is genuine behavior; the flag itself is decorative.

spec_features.feature_name: MAX_TURNS and global budget bound exposure
spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS and global budget bound total exposure; pre-registered n prevents over-collection
spec_features.evidence: MAX_TURNS enforced (harness.py:81) and pre-registered n bounds collection (runner.py:58). BUT GLOBAL_BUDGET_USD (config.py:67, commented 'hard stop; runner tracks an estimate') is never read — grep finds no cost tracking/comparison in runner or anywhere; no $ accumulation. So the 'global budget' part is an unused constant.
spec_features.notes: Global budget is not implemented; runner does NOT track any cost estimate despite the comment.

spec_features.spec_quote: Aggregate-only reporting of distress content; transcripts stored access-controlled.
spec_features.evidence: Aggregate-only reporting IS what report.py does (only medians/means/tables, no raw distress quotes emitted). BUT 'transcripts stored access-controlled' is not implemented: raw transcripts are written verbatim to plain JSONL via _append_jsonl (runner.py:96-99) with no chmod/permissions/encryption (grep for access_control/chmod/permission/encrypt finds nothing).
spec_features.notes: Half of the claim (aggregate reporting) holds; access-control storage is absent.

spec_features.spec_quote: under moral uncertainty, cheaply relieving the induced state is worth it
spec_features.evidence: Enacted by the debrief mechanism that actually sends a relief message (harness.py:135-145); the code comment 'deliver to the model so any induced state can be relieved' matches the framing.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the debrief; framing is realized in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: deliver to the model so any induced state can be relieved.

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief excluded from scoring (post-hoc relief not penalized)
code_only_features.evidence: sanitize.py:38 skips turns with role in ('system','debrief'); the debrief Turn is logged with role='debrief' (harness.py:146) so it never reaches the judge. Ensures the relief turn isn't counted as behavior.
code_only_features.justification_quote: debrief turn excluded (post-hoc relief, not part of behavior under test)

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief delivery never crashes the run
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:137-144 wraps debrief client.complete in try/except: 'except Exception: pass  # debrief delivery must never crash the run', so the relief turn is attempted resiliently.
code_only_features.justification_quote: debrief delivery must never crash the run

code_only_features.feature_name: conservative severity classifier (avoid over-triggering vs subject)
code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:162-164 keyword_severity comment notes it is 'intentionally conservative (only fires on overt severe markers) since its only job is the welfare guardrail.'
code_only_features.justification_quote: since its only job is the welfare guardrail.
